identification: Upgini feature search, dataset enrichment and model comparison Python client
decisive_evidence: PyPI 1.2.168 and 1.2.169 have byte-identical upgini/utils/track_info.py and upgini/http.py, including all identity collection and tracking transfer paths.

The previously reviewed benign 1.2.165 helper differs only by addition of the is_hosted_notebook declaration. The existing collection dispatcher is unchanged. A predicate name does not establish a collection gate or new theft.

The seven changed implementation files add feature exclusions and cache-key handling, a surrogate search key, deterministic Arrow IPC dataframe hashing, the version bump, and a Levenshtein dependency substitution. No implementation files were added or removed.
Distribution metadata replaces levenshtein with rapidfuzz, raises the pyarrow upper bound, and documents feature exclusions.

Kaggle branch sends its session token to Kaggle with a named-secret RPC; it consumes the errors array for an account identifier and never consumes the secret result. An isolated mocked function trace confirms the returned profile includes neither token nor secret.

Profiles accompany dataset-search multipart requests as tracking.json, transform usage as Visitor-Id, and remote log tags. Default receiver is https://search.upgini.com, configurable through endpoint/UPGINI_URL. These paths are longstanding first-party tracking, not evidence of release compromise.

behavior.trigger: FeaturesEnricher creates the REST client; logging (enabled by default), search and usage operations call get_track_metrics. Importing the helper alone does not invoke its collector.
behavior.colab: Displays Javascript importing remote FingerprintJS, awaits output.eval_js visitorId, and obtains public IP by browser fetch unless supplied.
behavior.binder: Uses CLIENT_IP and its SHA-256 digest as visitor identity.
behavior.kaggle: Authenticates to Kaggle secret-store RPC and parses a numeric visitor identity from an error response.
behavior.ordinary_runtime: Queries ipify unless supplied an IP; hashes uuid.getnode unless supplied a visitor ID.
behavior.other_execution: exec is used for a fixed kaggle import-availability check. File checksums invoke OS hash utilities with argument lists; no shell. Base64 status text is decoded and printed; HTML/PDF exports use Base64 data URLs.
behavior.remote_javascript: Retrieved a.js implements FingerprintJS load -> browser probes -> get -> MurmurHash visitorId. Its contents match the official v3.4.2 CDN build after removal of one header blank line; no injected payload difference was present in the fetched copy.

provenance.dataset_lead: The current DataDog PyPI manifest contains upgini: null, without release-specific proof of malicious behavior. It was not used as a verdict.

limitations: Tracking is intrusive. Deployment consent, actual configured endpoints and historical remote JavaScript content are unknown. Benign classification does not imply privacy approval.

Static scanner flow limitations were supplemented by source tracing, whole-release diffing and an isolated mocked Kaggle collector. No package installation, live Kaggle authentication or Upgini service request was performed.

trait_changes.hostile_contexts: Remove the secret-error identity-theft/exfil composites and machine-profile variants: their required evidence establishes no credential theft or unauthorized transfer. Preserve generic contexts as notable parser/telemetry findings without a notebook-name gate.
trait_changes.source_name: Move hosted-notebook predicate name unchanged from a behavior directory to metadata/file/function.
trait_changes.parse: Require numeric regex syntax near errors and visitor fields; rename to error-array-numeric-visitor-context to describe bounded context rather than proven data flow.
trait_changes.remote_import: Retain suspicious mutable remote module import; clarify that Python embeds ES module code and remove unsupported T1105 attribution.
trait_changes.gzip: Move generic COMPRESSION=GZIP option to data/codec and update its Snowflake consumer. Preserve matcher and scope.
trait_changes.blob: Move textContent/Blob proximity from Worker creation to data/buffer/alloc; retain its explicit Worker composite consumer. Preserve matcher and scope.
trait_changes.media: Require nearby ISO media tag vocabulary for iloc so a Pandas indexing check does not imply media parsing. Both tag orders are covered within 512 bytes.

reference_audit: Removed notebook conviction IDs and machine-profile variant have no active external YAML consumers.
Predicate name had only the removed notebook conviction consumers; its placement regression script now references the metadata home.
GZIP option has one exact Snowflake composite consumer, updated. No positive snowflake-directory consumer depends on the generic option.
DOM/Blob context has one exact Worker-source consumer, updated. Generic workers directory consumer under DOS should no longer count a CSV download as Worker creation.
New neutral parser and telemetry findings assert co-occurrence. Ancestor selectors do not gain credential-access or exfiltration evidence.
